view.apropos.blocks.p: An explanatory news outlet. Monday to Friday, one economic, financial or geopolitical story explained simply, for people to whom nobody has ever explained how money moves.

ul: **Three questions for every topic:** what is said, what it means, what it changes for you.
**Every figure is dated.** A price without its time means nothing.
**We go back to the source** (press release, official text, statistic) rather than copying an article. When a secondary source gets it wrong, we say so.
**When a fact cannot be verified, we write “unverified”.**
**We distinguish** what is in force, what is voted with future effect, and what is only a proposal.
**We correct.** Any error we find is corrected and flagged in the edition concerned.
We never recommend buying or selling anything. Éclipse is neither investment advice nor tax advice.
Investing carries a risk of losing capital. For any personal decision, consult a regulated professional.
To date, no sponsored content and no affiliate links.

view.apropos.blocks.p: Your e-mail address is used only to send Éclipse. It is neither sold nor shared, and you can unsubscribe at any time. If you write to suggest a topic or ask a question, your message (and your e-mail, if you leave it) is passed to us to reply and to choose our topics; it is never published. Search runs in your browser: your keywords are not sent to us. The site sets no advertising cookies. Your language choice is remembered in your browser and is not transmitted.
